## Teaching points

1. Look for ketosis, acidosis and volume depletion before arranging outpatient care for symptomatic hyperglycemia.
2. Review the steroid course with the prescriber and arrange a temporary glucose-management plan rather than giving an arbitrary one-off insulin dose.
3. Discharge requires oral intake, reliable monitoring and prompt follow-up; vomiting, confusion or inability to hydrate warrants reassessment.
